notes: Zone l60_north of the lot60 area: the buildings and everything north-east of them. The JSON is written by a generator (/tmp/claude-0/p4/lot60/l60_north/gen.py, scratch, not kept); this file is the source: edit it by hand and say so here. Digitised in a frame along the buildings' axis (t along 136 deg, s along 46 deg). Sources: the NJ 2020 ortho at 0.15 and 0.075 m (positions, paint), the 2017 LiDAR (building outlines from roof-edge returns, roof and ground heights), OSM (names, what a thing is; outlines only as a guide). Names: University Facilities and the Center for Clinical Services (montclair.edu), Lot 60N (OSM 287527901). Buildings: University Facilities and the Center for Clinical Services are one long red-roofed block joined at t 1127.7; both have low gables (rise 0.4 and 0.7 m); the Clinical building's white annex is a flat part 3 m higher. The LiDAR outlines lie up to 1 m from the OSM ones (the B/C border): the Clinical south-east end 1.0 m south-east of OSM's corner, Facilities' north-west wall 0.9 m inside the border (l60_lot's asphalt reaches t 1234.85, 0.7 m under that wall). North of Facilities: a white shed (2017 LiDAR and 2020 ortho), a white structure (2020 ortho only), two tanks (ortho): none is in OSM, all UNVERIFIED. Left out: a 15 by 13 m, 3.9 m high structure at (-145, 1515) in the 2017 LiDAR that is gone by 2020 (hatched paving there), a blue container and an orange container, vehicles, the rooftop units on the annex, the Great Notch Yard House, the substation and the NJT service road (outside the footprint). Ground: one asphalt surface from the walls to the footprint (the yard wall line), starting at y 1378.3 on the Village edge and running 0.2 m past the B/C border at the two open cuts; the walks along the south-west walls and the forecourts from the walls to 0.2 m past l60_lot's apron curb; no walk on the north-east sides (the LiDAR ground is flat to the walls; the dark band there is the buildings' shadow). Stalls: rows fitted by least squares through divider positions found as brightness ridges along the row (pitch 2.745 m, 9 ft): fits in each marking's evidence. The north-east side of Facilities has a row of parked cars with only short irregular marks between them: no stall lines drawn there. Lamps: no pole returns in the 2017 LiDAR in this zone; none placed. Trees come from tools/evidence/trees.py.
